title: Evolutes and involutes of framed curves in Euclidean 3-space
summary: We investigated the evolute of a space curve with singular points. As smooth curves with singular points, we apply the theory of framed curves. However, the involute corresponding to the evolute in the sense of the locus of the centre of osculating spheres has not been defined as far as we know. In this paper, we directly define the evolutes and involutes of non-degenerate curves and framed curves using the theory of Bertrand type curves.
